slides.title: Tired makes feelings *louder*.
slides.sub: What one sleep study saw in the brain.

slides.title: About 35 hours awake.
slides.body: UC Berkeley researchers kept healthy young adults up for about 35 hours, then showed them upsetting images in a brain scanner.

slides.title: Over 60% more reactive.
slides.body: The brain's emotional centers reacted over 60 percent more than in people who had slept that night.

slides.title: Upset, or tired?
slides.body: Before a sharp reply late at night, ask which one it is. If it's both, the talk can wait until morning.

slides.title: Watch the pattern for a week.
slides.body: Jot down your sharpest reactions and how you slept. See what lines up.
